definition_used: When a journal/publisher states that no manuscripts will be accepted from one or more authors of the original article. Bans could be for a limited time or indefinitely.
caution: Publishing ban is a post-publication sanction, not a direct indicator of manuscript content or process flaws. It reflects journal/publisher policy enforcement.
semantic_rationale: The definition describes a journal/publisher-imposed ban on future submissions from authors, which is a post-publication oversight action (publication_policy_or_sanction). It does not directly address research content, authorship integrity, or editorial governance, but fits post-publication transparency/due process/oversight broadly as a sanction notice.
